name: Child Tax Credit
valueBasis: Up to $2,200 for each qualifying child under 17, part of which is refundable.

criteria.instructions: Was this child under 17 at the end of the tax year? The Child Tax Credit uses a younger age limit than the Earned Income Tax Credit.
criteria.askIfUnsure: Was this child under 17 at the end of the year?
criteria.assumption: the children were under 17 at the end of the year
criteria.note: IRC 24(c)(1). A child aged 17 or 18 can still count for the Earned Income Tax Credit but not for this one.

criteria.instructions: Does this child have a Social Security number valid for employment?
criteria.askIfUnsure: Does this child have a Social Security number?
criteria.assumption: the children have Social Security numbers
